Notes

What I'm learning right now

This week

Starting email marketing from zero

I've just begun learning email marketing, and the first surprise was how much of it happens before you write a single subject line. Segmenting a list by interest and behaviour matters more than I expected — a generic blast performs worse than a smaller, targeted one. I built my first sequence this week: a three-email welcome flow, and I'm now comparing open rates to figure out what "good" actually looks like for a beginner list.

Last month

What Quality Score actually changes in Google Ads

I used to think a higher bid was the main lever in Google Ads. Running my own test campaign showed otherwise — Quality Score, driven by expected click-through rate, ad relevance and landing page experience, directly affects both your ad rank and your cost per click. Tightening my ad copy to match the exact keyword intent dropped my CPC noticeably, without touching the bid at all.

Earlier

Building my first WordPress site

My first WordPress build taught me that SEO setup isn't a final step, it's a foundation. I installed an SEO plugin halfway through and had to go back and redo my page titles, meta descriptions and image alt text. Next time I'd plan the site structure and keyword targets before writing a single page, not after.
